body.title: Add the read-only ReviewWorkers.progressOf accessor
body.summary: In src/daemon/threads/review-workers.ts add progressOf(key) returning a frozen structured clone of the entry's last accepted progress (incarnation, attempt, sequence, phase, completed, total, observation, display), or undefined when there is no entry, the entry is closing, or nothing has been accepted. It writes nothing, does not advance sequence, does not renew any grace and does not post to a worker.
acceptanceChecks: progressOf returns the last accepted progress after acceptPublication and undefined for an unknown or closing key
the returned value is a clone: mutating it does not change the entry
calling progressOf any number of times leaves e.progress.sequence, the board and worker messages unchanged
no existing ReviewWorkers method changes behavior

tests.name: src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-workers-progress-of.test.ts: progressOf returns a clone of the last accepted progress and undefined for a closing or unknown key
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-workers-progress-of.test.ts: progressOf is read-only and never advances sequence or renews grace
